_comment: Publication status per connector, enforced by scripts/publication_gate.py.
Every connector needs an entry, so adding one is a decision somebody makes
rather than a default somebody inherits. `blocked` connectors must not
carry a server.json: that file is the publication manifest, and its
presence is what a publishing pipeline keys on.
`ready` means the connector satisfies the rule in README.md: it talks to
somebody else's API, with the caller's own credentials and storage, and
works the same on a laptop as inside a platform. Nothing here means a
connector has been reviewed for anything else.

csv_to_sql.reason: Recovered from a v1 build and reworked for per-call connections. Not yet verified against a live deployment. Same rule as google_drive: run it end to end first.

filesystem.reason: Not yet verified against a live deployment, and it exposes the serving host's own disk rather than an API the caller holds an account with, so whether it meets the README rule depends on where it is deployed. Decide that before presenting it.

google_drive.reason: Not yet verified against a live deployment. Publishing a connector nobody has run end to end is a claim the maintainers cannot support. Run it end to end first.

linkedin.reason: Ported from the earlier implementation and not yet verified against a live deployment. Same rule as google_drive: run it end to end first.

surveymonkey.reason: Not yet verified against a live deployment, and at 40 tools it is the largest connector in the catalogue. Same rule as google_drive: run it end to end before presenting it as a flagship.

vanna.reason: Recovered from a v1 build and reworked for per-call credentials and caller-owned training storage. Not yet verified against a live deployment. Same rule as google_drive: run it end to end first.
